summary: Tested Twilio SMS OTP feature for CarryOn app. Fixed a critical bug in DELETE /api/auth/sms-otp endpoint where log_audit_event was called with incorrect parameters (user_id instead of actor_id). All 13 backend tests pass. Frontend code review confirms correct implementation of SMS OTP UI in Settings page and Login OTP modal.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: log_audit_event calls in sms_otp_verify and sms_otp_disable endpoints used incorrect parameters (user_id instead of actor_id, missing actor_email, actor_role, category)
Twilio A2P 10DLC campaign is FAILED - SMS messages will queue but not deliver. Backend handles this gracefully with 500 error and appropriate message
SMS OTP section in Settings correctly only shows when 2FA is enabled (!globalOtpDisabled && userOtpEnabled)
Login OTP modal correctly shows SMS/Email toggle when hasSmsOtp is true

demo_account.note: Admin account with OTP disabled platform-wide - SMS section won't show

context_for_next_testing_agent: SMS OTP feature is fully implemented. Backend endpoints: GET /api/auth/sms-otp-status, POST /api/auth/sms-otp-setup, POST /api/auth/sms-otp-verify, DELETE /api/auth/sms-otp. Login returns otp_method, has_sms, masked_phone when user has SMS enabled. Resend-otp accepts method parameter. Frontend: Settings page shows SMS section in Security card when 2FA is enabled. Login OTP modal shows SMS/Email toggle when hasSmsOtp is true. Note: Twilio A2P campaign is FAILED so actual SMS delivery won't work.
